trajectory.text:
Available tools:
- verify_emails: Simple REST API measuring email deliverability and quality. Get rid of spam traps, hard bounces, disposable or catch-all emails without breaking your budget.. This endpoint is for verifying emails.
- extract_url_data: To make a request, you simply include the target URL  API will return the data from that site. Optional configuration options, like proxies, location of the request, and more are possible to include."
- send_mail_smtp: send a mail from your own email provider (smtp)
- send_sms: Quickly integrate outbound SMS with a simple post request or our npm package.. The only endpoint you'll ever need.

I need to get the latest update from https://myblog.com/latest-update out to subscriber@example.com right away using smtp.mailprovider.com port 587 with user newsletter_bot and pass SecurePass123!. Once delivered, just ping my phone at +15550199 so I know it's done.
